title: Progressive backdrop blur behind floating bars
blurb: Composite a live scrollable HTML feed and floating top and bottom bars inside one WebGL 2 canvas with a multi-pass progressive Gaussian blur.
question: Can one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas run a multi-pass separable Gaussian blur that ramps smoothly behind a floating header and bottom capsule over a live scrolling feed, while keeping buttons and inputs in both subtrees clickable with updateElementGeometry()?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27, 412 px, 2.625 DPR): 6/6 live checks pass, 1.24 MP (927x1335, 9.9 MB) on one ElementGL context, smooth progressive RMS gradient (4.5 to 64.2 across y=10..145 px), and elementsFromPoint() hits buttons in both #pb-feed and #pb-chrome. Chrome 159 on Android and Playwright check:jank stay not verified.
